name: Plugin Update Notifier
description: Shows a notification badge on the admin's profile avatar and an entry in the profile menu when plugins have been installed or updated and the server needs a restart. The entry opens a dashboard page listing which plugins changed, their old and new versions, and each release's changelog.
overview: Badges the admin avatar when plugins change and a restart is pending.
